_readme: Panchang golden cases (ADR-008, PR-9). Content fills `cases` from two published panchangs. tithiIndex 0-29 (0 = Shukla Pratipada, 14 = Purnima, 15 = Krishna Pratipada, 29 = Amavasya) at local sunrise; nakshatraIndex 0-26 (0 = Ashwini) at local sunrise; sunrise/sunset HH:MM local. cityId from src/lib/cities.ts. Example: {"date":"2026-11-20","cityId":"pune","tithiIndex":0,"nakshatraIndex":0,"sunrise":"06:45","sunset":"17:58","source":"<panchang A> + <panchang B>"} (values illustrative, not real).
